name: CMS Section Editor - The Second Band Pointed At Its Own Cards

momentumSections.body:
The "What Your Gift Powers" cards. Their titles, copy, icons, and links are
edited in **Momentum Fund gift pillars**, not here — on the admin dashboard that
collection sits under /donate, alongside this one.

This entry decides where the band sits on the page and, via its Heading field,
what the band is called. Blank Heading keeps the shared "What Your Gift Powers"
title, which lives in `src/data/donatePage.json` as `pillarsTitle` and needs a
developer to change; filling Heading in here renames the band yourself, and is
what tells two pillars bands apart.

Which cards this band shows is the Card group box here paired with the Group box
on each pillar — type the same word in both. Blank on both sides shows the
ungrouped cards, which is how the band reads today, so leave Card group alone
unless you are splitting the band in two.

description: The duplicated pillars band that prompted this fix, opened at the moment its note is actually being acted on. Both controls the note describes are filled in here rather than blank: a Heading that gives the copy its own name instead of leaving two rows reading 'pillars', and a Card group naming the set of cards this band shows. That is the difference from the resting pillars entry — there the note explains what the boxes are for while both sit empty and the band shows the ungrouped cards; here it is the instruction an editor has followed. This is the state where the old note failed hardest: an editor duplicating a band and looking for the card copy was sent to a screen that does not exist, at exactly the point they needed to know that Card group here pairs with Group on each card.
